findings.claim: Forked persona is a duplicate authority with no drift detector; rule it SANCTIONED DIVERGENCE. The copy replaces the whole file, so two authors write one persona. The body carries the reply contract (JSON kinds, schema_version) that coryphaeus validates, so a stale fork fails validation: contract coupling to a file chorus no longer controls. The host-owned boundary (FR-001) is worth more than agreement, so the divergence is sanctioned. It still owes an owner (the project operator), a reason (FR-003 comment), and a drift detector; the spec offers only a manual re-compare.

evidence.note: The copy replaces the whole file and the installer will not update it.
Dispatch of roster personas whose replies are validated downstream.

findings.pull_quote: A sanctioned copy without a drift detector is a fork with a better story.

findings.claim: Staleness fails silently and lands on rank 1. A stale fork gives no error and no failing build, and host precedence hides the shipped file. It surfaces as vote or validation anomalies far from the cause. Trade-off: zero chorus code (simplicity, rank 4) bought with conformance (rank 1), paid by the retuner. Acceptable only if the recipe names the symptom ('validation failures after an update: check your copy first').

evidence.note: Risks table covers stale copies with prose and a manual re-compare only.
The fork cost is accepted as 'just the files'.

findings.pull_quote: Silent staleness is paid for later, by someone who no longer remembers the copy exists.

findings.claim: Name-based dispatch is assumed, not guaranteed, in canon. The spec's Assumptions say chorus dispatches by agent name; the canon says only 'Dispatch each roster persona with the Agent tool'. The feature rests on that, on host precedence and on whole-file replacement, which FR-006 forbids testing. This is semantic coupling to an external host, pinned nowhere a regression would catch. T001 tests it once; the host version should be a recorded fact.

evidence.note: Dispatch rule says Agent tool, not dispatch by name.
Assumptions section states by-name dispatch as an assumption.

findings.pull_quote: The feature stands on a dispatch rule the canon never states.
findings.need_info_reason: I did not read how the Round brief names the agent beyond SKILL.md line 135.

findings.claim: A non-code fitness function exists only for our side. FC4 already checks markdown references, so a link check on the README section and chorus-learn pointer is nearly free, and T005 runs it. Copies live in the retuner's repo, so no CI grep can see them, and reading them would breach FR-001. Stop at the link check; keep the drift detector in the recipe (F16).

evidence.note: FC4 already validates markdown file references.

findings.pull_quote: Our CI can guard the recipe, not the copies, and that is the right line.

findings.claim: Name the trade and record an ADR. Coupling: static coupling of a downstream file to the shipped body, plus operational coupling to host resolution. Gained: no config layer (ease of change, simplicity). Given up: update propagation and record visibility (Q-33). The retuner pays staleness; the maintainer pays unseen support load, since a round failing on a forked body looks like a chorus bug. Record these cost-bearers in an ADR.

evidence.note: Design decisions 3 and 4 accept the lost record visibility and the fork cost.

evidence.ref: Architect worldview rule 8: ADRs let decisions survive their author
evidence.note: Established in the architect persona's worldview.

findings.pull_quote: The saved machinery is paid back in unseen fork drift.

findings.claim: Top recommendation, zero chorus code: FR-003 should require the reason comment to include the shipped plugin version the copy was taken from, and FR-004 should name the staleness symptom and say 'check your copy first'. This gives each copy an owner, a reason and a cheap drift signal, turning F11's duplicate authority into a ruled divergence without breaching FR-001.

evidence.note: FR-003 and FR-004 ask for a reason comment and cost statement without a version stamp or symptom.
The plugin carries a version a copy can cite.

findings.pull_quote: Stamp the version in the copy, and the fork can at least tell you how old it is.
